property_summary: For any callee and calldata, if the low-level call performed by forward reverts, then forward must revert with a plain Error and not a Panic(0x01); the buggy assert(_s) instead produces a Panic when the call fails.
change_summary: Changed the success requirement from require(_s) to assert(_s); this introduces a Panic(0x01) revert instead of a plain Error when the external call fails.
